SELECT * FROM ( /** 主体评级 **/ WITH A AS ( SELECT ASSET_CODE, RATING FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BRATING.O_CODE ORDER BY BRATING.O_CODE,BRATING.GRADE_DATE DESC ,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT DESC) MY_RANK ,BRATING.O_CODE AS ASSET_CODE ,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT AS RATING FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING BRATING WHERE 1 = 1 AND BRATING.O_TYPE = '01' /*主体评级*/ AND BRATING.GRADE_DATE <= #{valDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) WHERE MY_RANK = 1 ), /** 债项评级 **/ B AS ( SELECT ASSET_CODE, RATING FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BRATING.O_CODE ORDER BY BRATING.O_CODE,BRATING.GRADE_DATE DESC ,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT DESC) MY_RANK ,BRATING.O_CODE AS ASSET_CODE ,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT AS RATING FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING BRATING WHERE 1 = 1 AND BRATING.O_TYPE = '02' /*债券评级*/ AND BRATING.GRADE_DATE <= #{valDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) WHERE MY_RANK = 1 ), /** 债券还本计划**/ E AS ( SELECT SEC_ID, REPAY_DT,REPAY_NET FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SEC_ID ORDER BY SEC_ID,REPAY_DT DESC) MY_RANK ,REPAY_DT ,REPAY_NET ,SEC_ID FROM CHB_SEC_REPAY_INFO WHERE REPAY_DT <= #{valDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) WHERE MY_RANK = 1 ) SELECT DC.ASSET_CODE AS aColumn, CASE WHEN DC.ASSET_CODE = 'OD' THEN '其他负债' WHEN DC.ASSET_CODE = 'CASH' THEN '活期存款' ELSE NVL(G06.ASSET_NAME, DC.ASSET_CODE) END AS bColumn, NVL(PLAN.ASSET_NAME,DC.PLAN_ASSET_ID) AS cColumn, NVL(DC.ISSUE_AMT, 0) AS dColumn, L.ASSETTOTLVAL AS eColumn, CASE WHEN DC.ASSET_CODE = 'OD' or G06.ASSETTYPE2 = '1902' THEN '负债' ELSE '资产' END AS fColumn, NULL AS gColumn, CASE WHEN DC.ASSET_CODE in ('OD', 'CASH') or G06.ASSETTYPE2 in ('1902', '1108') THEN 0 WHEN ZQ.FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL THEN DC.POS_NUM / NVL(E.REPAY_NET, 100) WHEN G06.ASSETTYPE2 = '1501' THEN DC.POS_NUM / 100 ELSE DC.POS_NUM end AS hColumn, SUB.MAP AS iColumn, DC.INT_AMT AS kColumn, DC.POS_AMT AS lColumn, CASE WHEN DC.ASSET_CODE = 'OD' THEN '2000' WHEN DC.ASSET_CODE = 'CASH' THEN '1001' ELSE G06.ASSETTYPE2 END AS oColumn, B.RATING AS pColumn, A.RATING AS qColumn, G06.RATING AS rColumn, NVL(DC.TOTAL_NUM,0) AS sColumn, CASE WHEN DC.ASSET_CODE = 'OD' THEN '2000' WHEN DC.ASSET_CODE = 'CASH' THEN '1001' ELSE G06.ASSETTYPE2 END AS assettype2, G06.IS_FBZB AS isFbzb, G06.BANK_SEC_ZXZQ AS bankSecZxzq, G06.IS_BZHPJ AS isBzhpj, G06.ISUNLISTED AS isunlisted, G06.BANK_SEC_KZZQ AS bankSecKzzq, G06.INDUSTRY1 AS industry1, G06.IN_ASSET_TYPE AS inAssetType, G06.MONIT_TYPE AS monitType, G06.PPPFLAG AS pppflag, G06.IS_GOVERN_FUND1 AS isGovernFund1, G06.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG AS privatefundFlag, G06.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG AS privateprdFlag, G06.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG AS bondtostockFlag, G06.MANAGE_TYPE AS manageType, G06.RATING AS rating FROM CHB_BOT_AST_POS DC
/*底层资产月报头寸*/ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT POS.ASSET_CODE ,POS.OLD_ASSET_CODE ,POS.ASSETTYPE2 ,POS.RATING ,POS.INDUSTRY1 ,POS.IN_ASSET_TYPE ,POS.MONIT_TYPE ,POS.PPPFLAG ,POS.IS_GOVERN_FUND1 ,POS.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG ,POS.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG ,POS.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG ,POS.MANAGE_TYPE ,CAI.ASSET_NAME ,CAI.IS_FBZB ,CAI.BANK_SEC_ZXZQ ,CAI.IS_BZHPJ ,CAI.ISUNLISTED ,CAI.BANK_SEC_KZZQ FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION POS
LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO CAI ON POS.ASSET_CODE = CAI.ASSET_CODE
WHERE POS.ENDDATE = #{valDate,jdbcType=DATE}
GROUP BY POS.ASSET_CODE ,POS.OLD_ASSET_CODE ,POS.ASSETTYPE2 ,POS.RATING ,POS.INDUSTRY1 ,POS.IN_ASSET_TYPE ,POS.MONIT_TYPE ,POS.PPPFLAG ,POS.IS_GOVERN_FUND1 ,POS.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG ,POS.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG ,POS.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG ,POS.MANAGE_TYPE ,CAI.ASSET_NAME ,CAI.IS_FBZB ,CAI.BANK_SEC_ZXZQ ,CAI.IS_BZHPJ ,CAI.ISUNLISTED ,CAI.BANK_SEC_KZZQ ) G06 ON DC.ASSET_CODE = G06.ASSET_CODE AND DC.PLAN_ASSET_ID = G06.OLD_ASSET_CODE
LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO PLAN ON DC.PLAN_ASSET_ID = PLAN.ASSET_CODE
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ASSET_ID, SUM(NVL(TDY_COST_AMT,0) + NVL(TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0) + NVL(TDY_INTINCEXP,0) + NVL(DELAY_PAY_AMT,0)) AS ASSETTOTLVAL FROM CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA WHERE VALUE_DATE = #{valDate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY ASSET_ID ) L ON DC.PLAN_ASSET_ID = L.ASSET_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PTL_ID, SUB.FINPROD_ID, MAX(MCP) MAP FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB SUB WHERE SUB.FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL AND MCP IS NOT NULL AND VAL_DATE = #{valDate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY PTL_ID, SUB.FINPROD_ID ) SUB ON SUB.PTL_ID = PLAN_ASSET_ID AND (SUB.FINPROD_ID = DC.ASSET_CODE or substr(SUB.FINPROD_ID,5) = DC.ASSET_CODE)
/** 估值表对应的资产科目类型,债券的数量需要乘以面值**/ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PTL_ID, FINPROD_ID FROM RSK_VALTBL_PRT_BOTASSET_MAP WHERE FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL AND SUB_CLASS = 'ZQ' GROUP BY PTL_ID, FINPROD_ID ) ZQ ON ZQ.PTL_ID = DC.PLAN_ASSET_ID AND ZQ.FINPROD_ID = DC.ASSET_CODE
LEFT JOIN A ON A.ASSET_CODE = DC.ASSET_CODE
LEFT JOIN B ON B.ASSET_CODE = DC.ASSET_CODE
LEFT JOIN E ON E.SEC_ID = DC.ASSET_CODE
WHERE POS_DATE = #{valDate,jdbcType=DATE} /**AND (CASH_FLAG is null or CASH_FLAG = '01') 有底层的剩余现金也展示**/ ) T
